Broader API market: $144.2B (2025) to $198.39B by 2030 (6.6%/yr).

structureFacts: Injectable demand growth outpaces the broader API market, driven by biologics, monoclonal antibodies and complex/specialty formulations
Sterile manufacturing carries high regulatory barriers to entry — multi-year approval cycles (USFDA/EU-GMP inspections, ANDA/dossier filings) constrain new entrants
Core inputs (APIs, water-for-injection, glass vials, rubber stoppers, aluminum seals) create a specific, capital-intensive supply chain
